semantic_target.claim_boundary: A bounded foot-ground contact factor below support. This does not establish full support, metaphysical contact, or load-bearing role structure.

dataset.name: Human gait and other movements - markers / inertial sensors / pressure insoles / force plates
source_facts: Two Moticon Insole3 pressure insoles with 16 pressure sensors per foot.
Synchronized CSV files contain optoelectronic marker trajectories, IMU signals, and insole data.
Walking gait events were detected from marker trajectories using the validated Zeni et al. algorithm and visually checked/corrected.
Force plates were not used for gait-event detection.
Vendor insole gait-event detection was not used.
Published synchronization precision is approximately 0.1 s; users are cautioned about synchronization.

trial_scope.rationale: Restrict to walking trial classes for which gait-event generation was described and avoid extra task-specific timing/turnaround complications.

participant_split.exclusion_reason: No insole data were recorded for Participant 01.
participant_split.note: Fixed before Yareta data are downloaded or outcomes are inspected.

evidence_separation.inference_inputs: Only the 16 pressure-sensor channels for the evaluated foot from synchronized insole data.
evidence_separation.primary_reference: Foot-strike and foot-off events derived from optoelectronic marker trajectories and visually checked/corrected by the dataset authors.
evidence_separation.optional_secondary_reference: Force-plate contact may be audited separately on steps crossing a force plate, but may not define or tune the primary v2 labels.

preprocessing.normalization: Within each trial and foot, map the 5th percentile to 0 and 95th percentile to 1, then clip to [0,1]. This unsupervised normalization uses no gait-event labels.

reference_construction.stance: from foot strike through the following foot off
reference_construction.swing: from foot off through the following foot strike
reference_construction.rule: A scoring window is reference-contact or reference-no-contact only if the full 200 ms window lies at least 150 ms from every gait-event boundary. All other windows are REFUSAL:near_event_or_uncertain for reference purposes.
reference_construction.fail_closed_alignment: If event times cannot be mapped unambiguously into the synchronized CSV time base, the affected trial is excluded and reported rather than heuristically shifted.

calibration.feature: median normalized summed plantar pressure over the 200 ms window
calibration.objective: Choose the center threshold on calibration participants only to maximize balanced accuracy with refusals counted as incorrect.

evaluation_metrics: coverage on held-out non-ambiguous reference windows
balanced accuracy with refusals counted incorrect

robustness.sensor_order_permutation: exact prediction invariance expected because the feature is the sum of per-foot pressure sensors
robustness.single_sensor_dropout: drop each of 16 sensor channels separately on held-out data and report coverage/error/refusal degradation without retuning
robustness.left_right_symmetry: same preprocessing, calibration threshold, and prediction code path for both feet

stop_rules: Do not modify the participant split, synchronization margin, normalization, candidate threshold grid, refusal width, or calibration objective after outcome inspection.
Do not claim full support grounding from foot-ground contact evidence.
Do not treat force-plate or optoelectronic channels as inference inputs.
Retain failed or low-coverage held-out results.
Any material protocol change requires experiment_plan_v3.json.
